```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tinytable)
targets::tar_config_set(
  store = here::here("_targets"),
  script = here::here("_targets.R")
)
targets::tar_load(c(penguins_clean, analysis_flipper_fit))
invisible(list2env(targets::tar_read(fn_figure), .GlobalEnv))
theme_set(theme_proj(size_base = 18))
options(
  tinytable_html_mathjax = TRUE,
  tinytable_quarto_figure = TRUE,
  tinytable_tt_theme = theme_mitex
)
```

## Slide conventions

- Decks are dated `YYMMDD_venue.qmd` and read pipeline targets, so slides never duplicate analysis code
- Chunk labels use `plot-*` / `table-*` prefixes to suppress auto-captions
- **One punchline per slide at most**; everything else stays plain text

## Example figure

```{r}
#| label: plot-flipper-fit
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = penguins_clean,
    aes(x = flipper_len, y = body_mass, color = sex, shape = sex),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = analysis_flipper_fit$pred,
    aes(x = flipper_len, y = body_mass, group = species),
    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  scale_sex(name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Flipper length (mm)", y = "Body mass (g)") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.12, 0.9)
  )
```
